description: Persisted schema-mutation regression suite. Each case applies JSON-pointer operations to a deep copy of the baseline artifact and states the expected schema verdict. expected = schema_reject means JSON Schema validation alone MUST reject the mutant; expected = schema_accept_rule_covers means the schema accepts the mutant and the named catalog rule is the normative protection; expected = guard_trip means the runner's own JCS guard MUST reject the case's probe object (runner self-test, no schema involved).

cases.description: Empty gates object on a CommitmentPoint (all six gates deleted).
cases.expected_reason: GateConfig requires all six gates (authority, evidence, reasoning, dependency, version, recourse).

cases.description: Junk binding_effect_basis lacking the required effect_type and adverse_outcome_possible.

value.notes: junk basis object with no effect_type and no adverse_outcome_possible

cases.expected_reason: BindingEffectBasis requires effect_type and adverse_outcome_possible.

cases.description: Authority gate reduced to task_owner only (no legal_authority_holder, no delegated_authority, no operation-of-law basis).
cases.expected_reason: AuthorityGate anyOf requires legal_authority_holder, delegated_authority, or operation_of_law with legal_source.

cases.description: Recourse gate missing recourse_state.
cases.expected_reason: RecourseGate requires recourse_state.

cases.description: Adverse-flag inconsistency: adverse_outcome_possible flipped to false while an adverse outcome (refused) remains in allowed_outcomes.
cases.expected_reason: Cross-field consistency is not expressible as a local schema constraint; the catalog rule is the normative protection.

cases.description: Deployment/orchestration keys smuggled into the evidence gate.
cases.expected_reason: Evidence gate is closed (additionalProperties: false); ICSL is not a workflow/orchestration engine (spec section 2 non-goal).

cases.description: governed_context deleted from the ProtocolVersion.
cases.expected_reason: ProtocolVersion requires governed_context.

cases.description: A seventh gate (notification) invented on the gate configuration.
cases.expected_reason: GateConfig is closed (additionalProperties: false); the gate set is exactly six.

cases.description: Prose dependency: a free-text string replaces a structured DependencyExpression.

ops.value: after the permit decision becomes final

cases.expected_reason: DependencyExpression admits only the closed structured forms; prose strings are rejected.

cases.description: Bare-string outcomes replace the structured Outcome objects.
cases.expected_reason: allowed_outcomes items must be Outcome objects with token and effect_class.

cases.description: Invalid binding_force value outside the closed vocabulary.
cases.expected_reason: BindingForce is a closed enum / mixed-object oneOf; 'mandatory' matches neither branch.

cases.description: Mixed binding_force with only one component.
cases.expected_reason: Mixed binding_force requires at least two distinct components (minItems: 2).

cases.description: commitment_type stripped from every CommitmentPoint (the original regression that dropped the IGSL v1/v1.1 field).
cases.expected_reason: commitment_type is required on every CommitmentPoint (ADR-008 restoration); validation must fail per CommitmentPoint.

cases.description: GENERIC used as a commitment_type (authoring placeholder leaking into a canonical artifact).
cases.expected_reason: GENERIC is deliberately absent from the CoreCommitmentType enum and is not EXTENSION.

cases.description: EXTENSION commitment_type without a commitment_type_extension declaration (conformance_class raised to Extended-L2 so the missing declaration, not class coupling, is what rejects).
cases.expected_reason: commitment_type = EXTENSION conditionally requires commitment_type_extension.

cases.description: EXTENSION declaration without fallback_semantics (conformance_class raised to Extended-L2 so the missing fallback, not class coupling, is what rejects).

value.definition: Facilitates coordination between parties without determining rights or obligations.
value.rationale: Corpus evidence: recurring FACILITATE acts across domains that no core type honestly classifies.

cases.expected_reason: CommitmentTypeExtension requires fallback_semantics (a core type, or the explicit string 'none'); silent undefined consumption is prohibited.

cases.description: Fully declared EXTENSION-typed CommitmentPoint inside a ProtocolVersion declaring conformance_class Core-L2.

value.definition: Facilitates coordination between parties without determining rights or obligations.
value.rationale: Corpus evidence: recurring FACILITATE acts across domains that no core type honestly classifies.

cases.expected_reason: Class coupling: EXTENSION-typed CommitmentPoints are permitted only in artifacts declaring Extended-L2; the baseline declares Core-L2 and the ProtocolVersion-level conditional must reject.

cases.description: Core-typed CommitmentPoint (DECIDE) carrying a commitment_type_extension declaration.

value.definition: Facilitates coordination between parties without determining rights or obligations.
value.rationale: Illegally attached to a core-typed CommitmentPoint.

cases.expected_reason: Bidirectional sealing: a core commitment_type prohibits commitment_type_extension; extension detail may not shadow a core classification.

cases.description: Receipt missing protocol_version_hash (version-identity binding stripped).
cases.expected_reason: protocol_version_hash is REQUIRED in the Receipt content core: every receipt binds to the canonical RFC 8785 hash of the ProtocolVersion its protocol_version_id names.

cases.description: Fully declared EXTENSION-typed CommitmentPoint with conformance_class OMITTED entirely (the second audit's exact probe: omission must not smuggle EXTENSION past the class coupling).

value.definition: Facilitates coordination between parties without determining rights or obligations.
value.rationale: Probe: omitting conformance_class must not license EXTENSION.

cases.expected_reason: Reverse class coupling: if any CommitmentPoint has commitment_type EXTENSION, conformance_class is REQUIRED and must be Extended-L2; omitting the declaration no longer bypasses the coupling.

cases.description: Runner self-test: the JCS guard must reject an object whose member name contains a non-ASCII character (RFC 8785 sorts member names by UTF-16 code units, Python by code points; ASCII member names are the canonical-profile precondition).

probe.café: member name contains U+00E9; the guard must trip before any bytes are hashed

nested.𝔘nicode: non-BMP member name; UTF-16 vs code-point ordering diverges here

cases.expected_reason: The guarded json.dumps approximation is JCS-equivalent only under the no-number AND ASCII-member-name preconditions; the runner must fail closed when either is violated.

cases.description: encoding_depth L1 declared alongside conformance_class Core-L3 (class-depth inconsistency).
cases.expected_reason: Class-depth coupling: a declared conformance class -Ln requires encoding_depth Ln or greater (Core-L3 requires L3); the ProtocolVersion schema conditionals enforce this.

cases.description: Embedded governed_context descriptor carrying runtime members (protocol_version_hash and current_time); the hash is a well-formed synthetic probe value, not an artifact identity.
cases.expected_reason: ProtocolVersion.governed_context is a GovernedContextDescriptor (description, subject_class, scope, jurisdiction_note; additionalProperties false): it must not carry runtime members, so no artifact ever embeds a hash of the object containing it and no placeholder-hash convention exists.

cases.description: Conformance declaration missing the claim-subject type discriminator.
cases.expected_reason: ConformanceDeclaration requires claim_subject_type so a harness can select subject-specific applicability without parsing the subject name.
